source.name: Score and Change, Overview of the 2026/2027 La Liga sponsors
source.note: The page's 2026/27 La Liga shirt-sponsors table lists Pamesa Cerámica as Villarreal's front-of-shirt sponsor. The same page notes 'Fernando Roig owns Pamesa Cerámica and became Villarreal's principal shareholder and president in May 1997'.

source.name: GAC Spain, GAC patrocinador oficial de Villarreal CF
source.quote: En virtud de este acuerdo, GAC se convierte en Official Sleeve Partner del Villarreal CF. El logotipo de la compañía ocupará la manga de la camiseta del primer equipo.

source.name: Blinkfire, Guia de los patrocinadores de la LALIGA 2025-26
source.quote: Villarreal CF Patrocinador principal de la camiseta: Pamesa Cerámica Patrocinador espalda camiseta (Parte inferior): Ascale Marca técnica: Joma
source.note: 2025-26 guide: Ascale on the back of the shirt. No 2026-27 source naming the back placement was found; Ascale remains on the club's official sponsors page and the Footy Headlines 2026-27 kit photos do not show a back-of-shirt logo.

source.name: Footy Headlines, Villarreal 26-27 Home Kit Released
source.quote: Official Release: Villarreal CF has officially launched their new home kit for the 2026-2027 season, manufactured by Joma.
source.note: Kit maker (technical sponsor), not a shirt-sponsor placement; listed as partner per the convention for kit suppliers. The club's sponsors page lists Joma among its official sponsors, and 433fc's LaLiga 2026/27 table lists kit manufacturer Joma for Villarreal.

summary: Pamesa Cerámica on the front (partnership since 2013/14), GAC as Official Sleeve Partner from September 2026, Ascale carried over on the back per the 2025-26 guide, Joma as kit maker. No 2026-27 source names the back placement, so the list isn't marked complete.
